scope: Displayed tonic/color regions only; no source edits, chord transposition, MIDI/note timing changes, or audio changes.

criteria.identity: Normalized chord root plus distinct compound intervals plus explicit bass; repeated symbols/holds and quality aliases do not add harmonies; clipped/unknown symbols compare literally.
criteria.zeroShifts: Consecutive identical tonic pitch classes form one actual color region, regardless of repeated source join labels or mode-only changes.
criteria.home: An initial C region is home context, not a modulation, and remains C even if it contains one harmony. Global source tonic/transposition is unchanged.
criteria.assignment: Contiguous singleton runs compare the preceding and following established multi-harmony contexts together; a single previous-to-next cut maximizes root/core-quality fit, cadential resolution, shared harmony and continuity. No greedy merge order.
criteria.initialNonC: Compare the following local context with global C plus an explicit C-home prior; do not transpose pitches or rewrite song.tonic.
criteria.terminal: With no following context, absorb into the preceding established context.
criteria.ambiguity: Audited runs with musical-score margin <=0.5 are weak/tied; continuity resolves remaining ties. Known source cases are manually reviewed using neighboring chords and phrase boundaries.
criteria.reviews: Known-case decisions require matching composition title, source beat, normalized chord, immediate preceding/following chord and both neighboring tonics. Written rationale and the automatic proposal remain in each decision.
criteria.forwardBoundaries: A following key may extend backwards to the singleton start; sourceBeat records its original analytical boundary and stale source-join grammatical metadata is omitted.
criteria.timing: Source chord, note and key/join JSON is immutable. Rawl note-midpoint coloring and its strict boundary comparison are unchanged.
